Hi Avery — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can lock a short product walkthrough: 

Recap (very high level)
- Primary goal: speed up claims triage for your CareOps team (target 30–40% faster manual steps).
- Key constraint: must integrate with on-prem EHR (FHIR) and meet current data-retention policy.
- Success metric: reduced mean time-to-close by end of Q4 for pilot cohort.
- Stakeholders to involve: Ops lead, Platform engineer (for network/K8s), Security reviewer.

Proposed next step — 30-minute walkthrough (we'll keep it focused on integration surface, typical infra footprint, and pilot criteria). I picked two prioritized windows plus a flexible fallback so you can coordinate stakeholders quickly: 

Option A (priority 1) — Tue 30 Jun, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
Option B (priority 2) — Wed 1 Jul, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
Fallback — Thu 2 Jul, 11:00–11:45 AM PT (45 min buffer if you want to include more folks)

Please reply with the option that works best and confirm who from Townsquare will join (Ops / Platform / Security). If none of these look good, tell me two windows that do work and I will coordinate on our side. 

I've attached a short discovery summary and dropped the HubSpot opportunity link below for your records. Once you pick a slot I'll send the calendar invite and include the concise agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

— Logan Wright
